ayahs.textAr: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.textEn: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺,

ayahs.textAr: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.
But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺,

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.
Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment?
Is Allah not the most just of all judges?
